evidence.title: Refunds And Duplicate Payments
evidence.text: Refund requests must be checked against the original payment record before an agent promises a resolution. For duplicate payments, support should ask for the invoice number, payment reference, and the last four digits of the payment method. If the duplicate charge is visible in the payment record, support may draft a refund ticket update and mark the case for finance review.

evidence.text: Refunds for cancelled workshops are eligible only when the cancellation was made at least seven days before the workshop date. Exceptional refunds require human review and must not be promised by the assistant.
